about.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

name: v1.4.201
body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️ Please note: It usually takes 48–72 hours for a landed PR to be released (except P0+ fixes). We have many more exciting PRs and features coming in later versions! ## The short version **Native chat:** Claude subagent activity and Codex background tasks are now visible in chat. Completed turns show changed files, and task updates stream into the composer. **Orchestration:** Worker-terminal ownership is established at creation. Startup, mobile input, and older federation coordinators have additional recovery safeguards. **Workspace & browser:** Background browser tabs load on open, and creating a chat preserves the active worktree. --- ## Product experience ### Workspaces, tabs & browser *Keep the current worktree selected, and trust a newly opened browser tab to be ready when you visit it.* **Tabs & browser** * fix(browser): load newly opened background tabs by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19633 * Unify tab surface selection across workspace activation by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19635 * fix(native-chat): keep worktree active during chat creation by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19753 ## Agents & workflow ### Native chat *The conversation gives you a much better read on what an agent did, is doing, and has delegated.* **Agent activity & results** * feat(native-chat): show Claude subagent activity on the shared carrier by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18806 * feat(native-chat): report Codex background tasks in the chat strip by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19346 * Summarize turn file changes and preserve resolved prompt receipts by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19229 * Render task checklists with update diffs and a composer progress panel by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19230 **Composer & controls** * fix(native-chat): place effort to the right of model picker by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19617 * Show picker-selected native chat skills as pills by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19616 * fix(native-chat): expand Claude slash commands sent with an attachment by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19654 * fix(native-chat): reveal message chrome on keyboard focus, not any focus by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19426 * fix(native-chat): keep collapsible chevrons beside their header text by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19656 * fix(renderer): align native chat pane layering by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19626 **Chat & workspace routing** * Unify native chat and workspace tab command dispatch by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19621 * fix(native-chat): unify launch routing and support structured worker placement by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19431 ### Automations *Workers have a clearer owner from their first moment and are less likely to get stranded during recovery, federation, or mobile use.* * fix(orchestration): own a worker terminal from creation, not after the boot wait by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19608 * fix(orchestration): fence worker release on mobile keystrokes by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19337 * fix(orchestration): worker-start settles readiness on observed turn start, not write acceptance by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19423 * fix(orchestration): unify structured-session status across worktree ps and sidebar by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19217 * fix(orchestration): accept a missing Run id from older federation coordinators by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19689 * fix(orchestration): file mail from terminals in no Run under an unbound Run by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19696 * test(orchestration): pin the Run-required contract for unbound direct mail by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19684 ## Quality & delivery *Nothing here changes what you see — it changes how smoothly Orca behaves under real workloads. Expanded below if you want the detail.*
Performance: interface, chat & workspaces * perf: preserve store state on unchanged document titles by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19459 * perf: index document history workspace and path identities by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19461 * perf: index unified tabs for browser palette entries by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19464 * perf: append to owned project source lists without repeated copying by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19465 * perf: lazily index workspace tabs during terminal binding replay by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19466 * perf: replay pending chat asks with a FIFO cursor by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19496 * perf: group chat history sequences lazily within result windows by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19501 * perf: measure sidebar row geometry once before sorting delete anchors by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19503 * perf: index discovered skill IDs and names for batch selection by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19507 * perf: skip fuzzy ranking when exact file matches fill the window by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19509 * perf: index tab membership when rebasing authoritative sessions by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19510 * perf: reuse collators when sorting discovered skills by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19440 * perf: reuse collators when scanning Warp themes by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19441 * perf: index selected ancestor coverage during sidebar drag by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19443 * perf: index Resource Manager labels and accumulated workspace rows by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19480 * perf: scope activation inventory to the owning host and workspace by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19447 * perf: index closed browser page IDs during focus cleanup by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19449 * perf: index observable skill installations by locked name by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19451 * perf(runtime): skip hibernation inventories without completed agents by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19391 * perf(workspaces): skip unchanged heartbeat subscriber work by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19392 * perf: resolve current-workspace document addresses before catalog scans by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19495 * perf: materialize only the requested recent plugin audit lines by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19498 * perf: stop merging OS-opened files at the pending queue cap by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19508
Performance: terminals, tunnels & runtime * perf: track pane alias singleton or ambiguity without copying buckets by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19479 * perf: retire exhausted buckets from host-balanced listings by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19493 * perf: avoid repeated pending SOCKS payload copies by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19439 * perf(terminal): avoid quadratic status-marker scans in output bursts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19373 * perf: index selected-host SSH leases by PTY by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19467 * perf: drop oversized diagnostic records before retaining serialized text by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19445 * perf: bound tool pairing and avoid unused attribution arrays by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19468 * perf: validate terminal adoption MRU membership with group sets by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19482 * perf: index terminal neighbor order and remaining membership by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19453 * perf: count command-line escapes without regex match arrays by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19499 * perf: check backfill date cardinality before expanding ranges by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19456 * perf: probe requested pane keys instead of enumerating records by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19494 * perf(terminal): skip plain text between partial escape sequences by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19393 * perf(terminal): release oversized backing strings behind pending controls by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19396 * perf(terminal): skip ordinary output in preview control scans by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19400 * perf(terminal): own retained tail rows so they stop pinning their chunks by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19528 * perf: check tunnel queue capacity before copying frame payloads by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19497 * perf: stop queued metadata work after watcher cancellation by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19446
Performance: data & integrations * perf: prune metadata caches only when an entry can expire by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19450 * perf: skip folder-scope construction for separate repository imports by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19452 * perf: index usage session breakdowns during aggregation and merge by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19487 * perf: reuse AI-vault path matchers and query and sort keys by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19469 * perf: cache AI-vault project attribution by host and cwd by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19470 * perf: select checks-panel workspace attribution in one pass by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19471 * perf: cache update timestamps for Linear and Jira result sorting by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19473 * perf: reuse naturally ordered unique Codex trust ranges by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19492 * perf: reuse normalized task-page repository selection by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19454
Reliability & maintenance * test(ci): replace fixed teardown waits with bounded polls by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19720 * fix(lint): preserve deliberate collator benchmark baselines by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19686 * fix(native-chat): merge duplicate native-chat-types import by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19698 * refactor(ai-vault): split the session scanner into a transcript reader and consumers by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19666
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stablyai/orca/compare/v1.4.199...v1.4.200
